It may also list recorded observations that differ from what those structured hypotheses predict.
The observation pages and hypothesis.html are the same as in the earlier call.
For each listed hypothesis you may keep it (do nothing), submit a revision (a new form whose Revises field names its H-number), or withdraw it (an abstention whose Revises field names its H-number).
Forms that name no H-number are new hypotheses.
The earlier submissions are kept in every case.
Report only what the observations support.
Submit at most 8 forms.
